Calculate ${\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s,$ where $C$ is the line segment shown above.
feedback.worked_solution:
The line integral of unity with respect to arc length over $C$ is equal to the arc length $L$ of $C,$ i.e.,

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=L.
$$

In this case, the path $C$ is the hypotenuse of a right triangle whose legs have lengths $3$ and $6:$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14057099/assets/d0d9f0fad038f04b6d93920979161694f4e709a31b68083f20e768bf60aa1675.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}L & =\sqrt{{3}^{2}+{6}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{9+36} \\  & =\sqrt{45} \\  & =3\sqrt{5}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=3\sqrt{5}.
$$
